verdict.rationale: n8n's self-hosting options (Docker Compose, on-premises, private cloud) let AI-native users keep all workflow data on their own infrastructure, which indirectly prevents vendor-side use of data for AI training. However, there is no explicit n8n policy statement addressing AI training data usage, no data-processing/DPA language, and no claim about third-party model providers' training use of data passed through n8n. Missing for 10: explicit AI-training data policy, DPA/privacy documentation addressing model training, clarity on data handling when using cloud-hosted n8n or connected LLM providers.
